scientific_audit.scope: Independent plan/success/parent/selection/history/budget/options/native replay/legal PV/cleanup audit; reused complete plan-aware artifact verification without duplicate full artifact hashing; no engines or retrieval
scientific_audit.procedure_source:
import json,hashlib,gzip,sys,collections
from pathlib import Path
P=Path('docs/m5/evidence/msh161/cloud-primary');H=P/'batch-03-followup';C=P/'local-cache';sys.path.insert(0,str(P.parent.resolve()));import analysis,screen_v1,chess
data=lambda p:Path(p).read_bytes() if Path(p).exists() else gzip.decompress(Path(str(p)+'.gz').read_bytes())
read=lambda p:json.loads(data(p));sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(data(p)).hexdigest()
plan=read(H/'plan.json');ver=read(H/'results/verification.json');done=read(H/'results/completion.json');rest=read(P/'autoclaim-restoration.json');idx=read(P/'batch-03-review/review-index.json')
assert sha(H/'plan.json')==ver['plan_sha256']==done['plan_sha256'];assert sha(H/'results/verification.json')==done['verification_sha256'];assert sha(P/'batch-03-review/review-index.json')==plan['review_index_sha256'];assert sha(C/plan['original_manifest']['key'])==plan['original_manifest']['sha256']
for s in plan['selection_files']:assert sha(P/'batch-03-adjudication'/s['file'])==s['sha256']
for s in plan['consumed_successes']:assert sha(C/s['key'])==s['sha256']
canonical={};parents={}
for pair,x in idx.items():
 if pair not in {d['pair'] for d in plan['decisions']}:continue
 item=x['game_pair'];raw=gzip.decompress(Path(item['artifacts']['pair/report.json.gz']['local']).read_bytes());outer=json.loads(raw);rep=json.loads(outer['report_json']);ds,gs=analysis.extract_decisions(rep)
 assert rep['config']['claim_policy']=='auto_claim'
 for d in ds:canonical[pair,d['game'],d['ply']]=d
 parents[item['job']['id']]={'raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'compressed_sha256':item['artifacts']['pair/report.json.gz']['sha256'],'pair':pair,'success_sha256':item['success_sha256']}
vr={r['job']:r for r in ver['results']};assert len(vr)==len(plan['jobs'])==7
flags=collections.Counter();counts=collections.Counter();resources=collections.Counter();envs={};query_keys=[];discoveries=[]
for job in plan['jobs']:
 jid=job['id'];path=C/job['experiment']/'jobs'/jid/'success.json';assert sha(path)==vr[jid]['success_sha256'];r=read(path);assert r['job']==job and r['status']=='complete' and r['result']['complete'];assert job['build']==rest['original_build'];assert job['environment']['cloud']['image']==rest['original_image'];assert job['source_revision']==rest['original_worker_source'];assert job['nodes']==20000000
 parent=parents[job['inputs']['report']['job']];d=canonical[parent['pair'],job['game'],job['ply']];assert job['adjudication']['decision']==d;assert job['adjudication']['parent_success_sha256']==parent['success_sha256'];assert job['adjudication']['screen_success_sha256']==idx[parent['pair']]['reference_screening']['success_sha256']
 env=r['environment'];assert env['architecture']=='x86_64' and env['gcp']['machine-type'].endswith('/c3-standard-4') and env['batch']['BATCH_TASK_RETRY_ATTEMPT']=='0';envs[env['gcp']['id']]=env['gcp'];resources['job_wall_seconds']+=r['wall_seconds'];resources['job_cpu_seconds']+=r['child_cpu_seconds']
 arts=r['artifacts'];rr=read(C/arts['replay.json']['key']);assert rr['returncode']==0 and rr['input_sha256']==parent['compressed_sha256'] and rr['uncompressed_sha256']==parent['raw_sha256'];assert arts['replay-input.json']['sha256']==parent['raw_sha256']
 m=read(C/arts['analysis/manifest.json']['key']);assert m['nodes']==20000000 and m['planned_decisions']==1 and m['options']==analysis.OPTIONS and m['engine_sha256']==rest['original_build']['engines']['stockfish19']['sha256']
 qs=[read(C/a['key']) for k,a in arts.items() if k.startswith('analysis/g') and '-attempt' in k];assert len(qs)==(1 if job['move'] else 2)
 for q in qs:
  assert q['decision']==d and q['nodes_requested']==20000000 and q['options']==analysis.OPTIONS and q['engine_sha256']==m['engine_sha256'];assert q['status']=='complete' and q['exit_code']==0 and q['process_group_settled'] and not q['raw_truncated'];forced=q['forced_move'];assert (forced==job['move']) if job['move'] else forced in [None,d['played']]
  b=analysis.board_for(d);assert chess.Move.from_uci(q['assessment']['bestmove']) in b.legal_moves
  if forced:assert q['assessment']['bestmove']==forced
  score=q['assessment']['score']
  if score:
   assert q['pv_independent_legal']
   for u in score['pv']:b.push_uci(u)
  else:assert 'no_nonbound_score_aligned_with_bestmove' in q['assessment']['uncertainty']
  cmds=[e['line'] for e in q['raw_uci'] if e['direction']=='send'];assert 'ucinewgame' in cmds and 'setoption name Clear Hash' in cmds;assert 'position fen '+d['initial_fen']+(' moves '+' '.join(d['history']) if d['history'] else '') in cmds;assert [x for x in cmds if x.startswith('go ')]==['go nodes 20000000'+(' searchmoves '+forced if forced else '')]
  v=screen_v1.describe(q);flags.update(q['assessment']['uncertainty']);flags['directional_bound_conflict']+=bool(v['directional_bound_conflicts']);flags['stable_report_heuristic']+=v['stable_report_heuristic'];resources['query_wall_seconds']+=q['wall_seconds'];resources['query_cpu_seconds']+=q['child_cpu_seconds'];resources['query_wall_max_seconds']=max(resources['query_wall_max_seconds'],q['wall_seconds']);counts['queries']+=1;query_keys.append([parent['pair'],d['game'],d['ply'],forced])
  if forced is None:discoveries.append({'pair':parent['pair'],'game':d['game'],'ply':d['ply'],'played':d['played'],'bestmove':q['assessment']['bestmove'],'different_move':d['played']!=q['assessment']['bestmove'],'flags':v['flags']})
 res=read(C/arts['analysis/resources.json']['key']);assert res['failures']==0 and res['attempts']==len(qs)
 for k in ['wall_seconds','child_cpu_seconds']:assert abs(res[k]-sum(q[k] for q in qs))<1e-5
 counts['jobs']+=1
assert counts['queries']==7;assert len(discoveries)==0
assert len(ver['attempts'])==7 and not ver['failed_attempts'];assert all(a['status']=='complete' for a in ver['attempts']);assert abs(resources['job_wall_seconds']-ver['successful_job_totals']['wall_seconds'])<1e-5
for d in plan['decisions']:
 qs=[k for k in query_keys if k[:3]==[d['pair'],d['game'],d['ply']]];assert set(q[-1] for q in qs)==set(d['moves'])-{d['played']}
for j in plan['jobs']:
 folder=C/j['experiment']/'jobs'/j['id'];assert not (folder/'claim.json').exists();assert len(list(folder.glob('attempts/*/receipt.json')))==1
assert sha(P/'batch-03-adjudication/plan.json')==plan['prior_plan_sha256']
reused=[]
for d in plan['decisions']:
 qd=d['reused_played'];assert sha(C/qd['success']['key'])==qd['success']['sha256'];assert sha(C/qd['artifact']['key'])==qd['artifact']['sha256'];r=read(C/qd['success']['key']);q=read(C/qd['artifact']['key']);assert qd['artifact'] in r['artifacts'].values();assert q['decision']==canonical[d['pair'],d['game'],d['ply']];assert q['forced_move']==d['played'] and q['nodes_requested']==20000000 and q['options']==analysis.OPTIONS;assert q['engine_sha256']==rest['original_build']['engines']['stockfish19']['sha256'];assert q['status']=='complete';assert qd['job'] not in {j['id'] for j in plan['jobs']};reused.append(qd)
result={'status':'passed','jobs':7,'queries':7,'decisions':len(plan['decisions']),'discoveries':discoveries,'reused_played_queries':reused,'counting':'Only seven new jobs/queries counted; seven reused played queries stay in earlier panel totals','flags':dict(flags),'resources':dict(resources),'worker_environments':envs,'failed_scientific_attempts':0,'unresolved_claims':0,'plan_sha256':sha(H/'plan.json'),'verification_sha256':sha(H/'results/verification.json'),'source_revision':read(H/'launch.json')['reviewed_revision'],'scope':'Independent plan/success/parent/selection/history/budget/options/native replay/legal PV/cleanup audit; reused complete plan-aware artifact verification without duplicate full artifact hashing; no engines or retrieval','procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('/tmp/msh161-b03-followup-audit-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['status','jobs','queries','decisions','flags','resources']},indent=2));print('Distinct discovery alternatives:',[d for d in discoveries if d['different_move']])
